May 20th
Back at the camp. I really need to fix the holes in the new building before someone gets hurt.

June 3th
Some kids say they heard a baby screaming last night. Probably just to scare the younger ones...

June 10th
New owner. Seemed to have a bit of a temper. Better to just stay out of the way and focus on my work.

June 27th
I think there's something in the water... Feeling kinda uneasy...

July 2nd
A kid went missing last night. The sheriff is shutting the camp down until further notice. Should probably look for a new job.

As I sit here at my final resting place, contemplating my last words, only one thing comes to mind.
Fuck all of you...
I'm burning down the factory and cursing the lake you sought to protect.
May you never find peace when my blood still flows.
